posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I agree with Arenson.

 

Also the intitial launch was seak on value.  I can understand the early stretch rewards being stuff you know is oging to get achieved quickly, but that left the initial pledge options pretty bare.

People reacted to that, and were right to, if they are looking to get the game for as little as they can, which I won't blame anyone for doing.

Frankly, GtG isn't living or dying with this launch, they don't need our support to be able to keep making SotM anymore, and they aren't going to run kickstarters designed to undercut retail options, they need those relationships.

Basically Kickstarter is better than taking out a loan and hoping the game sells, but there really isn't a "I need to help this company so they don't go under and stop making cool stuff" angle with this kickstarter.

Investing in this game because you are a hardcore fan who just wants the chance to throw money at GtG is a legit position to take.  A lot of us fall under that category.

Others are going to look for something that makes them special if they invest, if there is a chance to get it for less a few weeks after everyone gets it then that chance needs to be offset, and not just with art prints, with stuff that says "I'm special, I got here first"

That's what they were looking for, exclusives.  They will come back, the economics of investment are changing.

 

I also want to say I respect that >G is leaving SotM completely out of this Kickstarter, it would be easier to get people to buy Tactics if they threw in some shiny SotM promos or a new deck, but having this game stand on its own is awesome.

The other reason we're not putting SotM promos or products in this Kickstarter is that we don't want to force this game on SotM fans. If you look through the rules and watch (next week's) game play video and go, "Eh, this game isn't for me," that's totally fine! If people are enough into our stories and characters that they want the game based on that alone, that's awesome. But I don't want anyone to have to buy a game they don't want.
